paragraphs: R. Yishmael ben Elazar, Shabbat (32, end of side a), Jerusalem Talmud, chapter HaRo'eh, halakhah 3, and Tosefta, Kilayim, chapter 3. R. Matya ben Ḥarash went to him; there is another version. There is also R. Elazar ben Yishmael, or son of R. Yishmael.
